title.narrative: DFAT Pacific Regional Trade Development Investment

description.narrative: EDRMS - 22/18712#7 Funding under this investment is to support the EGS team’s work on trade development in the Pacific. In particular, it will support activities with the Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) Secretariat including funding the Pacific Trade Invest (PTI) Australia office in Sydney and the PIF’s permanent representation to the WTO in Geneva. Given that Pacific Island countries rely on trade, tourism, and foreign direct investment, both offices’ work aligns well with Australia’s policy framework for support to the Pacific Islands in the post-COVID recovery era. A review of PTI Australia was carried out in July 2022, and a review of the PIFS Geneva Office was carried out in July 2023. Both reviews commended the work being done and recommended the continuation of Australia’s support to the offices.
